Strength technique

Progress stays in this browser, on this device. Player links select a profile; they do not sync records or grant site access.

Parent setup & workout rules

Both players have soccer experience and are learning lifting technique. A qualified instructor should check each player’s readiness and form. Each uses his own suitable resistance.

Learn technique with qualified adult supervision. Use light weights and stop with about three good reps still available. Stop an exercise if it hurts. No racing, maximum lifts, or lifting to failure.

Week 1: one set. Week 2: repeat; add a second set only if form and recovery are good. Weeks 3–4: keep weights steady and build controlled reps. Do not increase sets, reps and weight together.

Choose sessions around team training and matches. Keep strength sessions on separate days. If tired, sore or close to a game, choose recovery or a short learning session.

AAP youth resistance training guidance

BLUE · Count repsPURPLE · Timed holdAMBER · RestGREEN · Checked off

One rep = one complete movement. One set = the whole group of reps.

Move slowly enough to stay in control. Check off a set only after you finish it. Timers never mark work complete automatically.
